visualCharacteristics.purpose: 4-up edge-to-edge tall portrait image tiles, each tile fully linked, with an uppercase label at the bottom
visualCharacteristics.layout: 4 columns on desktop, 2 on mobile; image covers tile, label overlaid at bottom
visualCharacteristics.source: https://bradescobank.com/en/ section rc6 (Private Bank, Personal Bank, US Residents, Business)

contentPattern.structure: one row per tile: image cell | label cell containing a link (the link target becomes the whole-tile link)

reuseGuidance: Reuse for image-only navigation tiles with a single label; use cards-product when cards carry eyebrow, description and CTA.
